color.$description: Semantic colours, light theme. Names carry intent; components use these (or component tokens), never primitives. States move away from the page background (darker in light mode).

default.$description: PROPOSED: one off-black for all text (BENCHMARK-INFORMED lesson 4). Replaces #000000, #212529 and #333333. 17.04:1 on white.

subtle.$description: OBSERVED: secondary text. 5.77:1 on white, 5.20:1 on surface.subtle.

inverse.$description: OBSERVED: text on dark surfaces. 12.71:1 on navy, 17.04:1 on ink.

disabled.$description: PROPOSED: disabled text (decision 12). Exempt from WCAG contrast, kept readable anyway: 3.25:1 on surface.disabled.

default.$description: OBSERVED: the one link colour (BENCHMARK-INFORMED lesson 3). 6.80:1 on white.
OBSERVED: page and card background (14 exp).

subtle.$description: OBSERVED: grey sections and fills (14 exp).

hover.$description: PROPOSED: hover fill for secondary, tertiary and plain controls. Not observed.

pressed.$description: PROPOSED: pressed fill, one step darker than hover. Not observed.

inverse.$description: OBSERVED: dark surfaces (#232323, #242a2a) consolidated to ink.

overlay-control.$description: OBSERVED: translucent controls and labels over photos. Ink on it stays at 12.07:1 or more even over a black photo.

default.$description: OBSERVED: decorative dividers and card outlines. No contrast requirement.
PROPOSED: field, checkbox and select boundaries (decision 5). Observed #b1b3b0 at 2.11:1 became 3.81:1 on white, 3.43:1 on surface.subtle.

disabled.$description: PROPOSED: disabled boundary (decision 12). Exempt from contrast.

action.$description: Dark blue for all actions, checked and selected states (decision 1).

default.$description: OBSERVED: dark blue text and outlines (secondary button). 10.98:1 on white, 9.90:1 on surface.subtle.
OBSERVED: white on dark blue buttons.
PROPOSED: not observed; required. 6.80:1 on white, 6.13:1 on surface.subtle. Always offset from the control.

inverse.$description: PROPOSED: on dark surfaces, where the blue ring is only 1.87:1 on navy. White is 12.71:1.

error.$description: PROPOSED: error text, icons and borders (decision 7). 7.37:1 on white. Only 1.49:1 from the action dark blue, so always paired with an icon and a message.

success.$description: PROPOSED: not observed. 5.32:1 on white, 4.80:1 on surface.subtle.

feature.$description: OBSERVED: dark blue 'Virtual Tour' label (64 el).

typography.$description: 12 type styles (decision 4), down from 76 observed on the core journey (the benchmark: 37). Each style is size, line height and weight as separate tokens, so CSS and Figma can bind them individually. Line heights keep AcmeCo's 1.5x rhythm up to 20px (decision 9).

font-weight.$description: OBSERVED: body text at regular weight.

font-size.$description: OBSERVED: 16/400/24 is the most common style (11 exp).

font-weight.$description: OBSERVED: body text at regular weight.
OBSERVED: body text at regular weight.

font-size.$description: PROPOSED: form labels and UI labels.

font-weight.$description: OBSERVED: body text at regular weight.

font-size.$description: OBSERVED: prices shown at 12 to 20px across 11 variants; one prominent size.
